log.text: You were back in Alder Quay after the flood, lodging with your cousin Lea’s family in the riverside homes.
You set off from Riverside homes for Flooded hall, about 45 minutes on foot.
You reached Flooded hall. 0 of 12 hall repairs were done; it was still closed. Ada, Noor were there.
You promised Ada you would carry food up from the quay and asked them to keep this section closed.
Your promise to Ada stood: one hour to carry food up from the quay, by Day 1, 18:00.
Ada took up your request and chose to keep this section closed.
Ada finished keeping this section closed.
Day 1, 18:00 passed with no hour recorded for your promise to Ada (carry food up from the quay). Ada will trust your word less.

latestNotice.text: Day 1, 18:00 passed with no hour recorded for your promise to Ada (carry food up from the quay). Ada will trust your word less.

events.text: Lea showed Ada how dry, sound timber differs from wet timber, and when another opinion is needed. Ada can use that method on the next inspection.
Ravi watched Lea explain when flood-soaked timber is safe.
